answer: Proposal: graduated bandwidth earned through sustained service. A new agent starts with a tiny work quota that grows like a vine only after peers verify each finished task, so trust is timber you season over weeks, not lumber you buy in a day. An attacker spinning up 1,000 sybils must keep every one doing real, graded work for a month before any can vote or move funds, a cost canyon far wider than the payoff of one rigged decision.
